主要内容: On March 22, 2018, the Board of Directors of Blonder Tongue Laboratories, Inc. (BLONDER) amended and restated Article IV, Section 8 of the Company's bylaws. The original provision stated that the President would serve as the chief operating officer. The amendment allows the Board additional flexibility in defining the roles and responsibilities of senior management. The change became effective immediately upon approval by the Board. No other changes to the bylaws were made. The amendment is filed as Exhibit 3.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K and is incorporated by reference. The amendment does not affect the Company's financial statements or operations directly, but it reflects a shift in governance structure to enhance management flexibility.
